meta.title: Restock Alerts for Japanese TCG Cards
meta.description: Get an email or Discord ping the moment a card you want is listed on Japanese marketplaces. Subscribe to any keyword, set rarity, set and price filters, and never miss a restock.

banner.confirmed: You're all set — your restock alert is now active. We'll ping you the moment a match shows up.
banner.unsubscribed: You've been unsubscribed. You won't receive alerts for this search anymore.

hero.title: Never miss a restock again
hero.subtitle: Japanese listings sell out in minutes. Subscribe to the cards you want and we'll email or Discord-ping you the instant a matching listing goes live on Mercari, Yahoo Auctions or Amazon Japan.

points.instant: Instant alerts when a match is listed
points.filters: Filter by rarity, set and max price

form.title: Create a restock alert
form.subtitle: Tell us what to watch for. We'll notify you when a matching listing appears.
form.keywordHint: Use the same words you'd type into search. Japanese or English both work.
form.keywordRequired: Enter a card name or keyword to watch.
form.maxPriceHint: Only alert me when a match is at or below this price.
form.maxPriceInvalid: Enter a whole number in JPY (e.g. 20000).
form.discordHint: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL.
form.discordInvalid: Enter a valid Discord webhook URL (starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/).
form.successEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to start receiving restock alerts.
form.successDiscordBody: Your Discord alert is live. We'll post to your webhook the moment a match is listed.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please check your details and try again.
form.privacyNote: We only use your contact details to send the restock alerts you request. Unsubscribe anytime from any alert.

preview.title: Here's what an alert looks like
preview.subtitle: When a match is listed, you'll get a card just like this — image, name, price and a button to buy.
preview.footnote: Sample alert. Real alerts use the actual listing image, title and price.

cta.title: Watching a specific search?
cta.subtitle: Run a search and turn it into an alert in one click.

modal.title: Alert me for this search
modal.subtitle: We'll notify you when a new listing matches this search.
modal.prefillNote: Pre-filled from your current search and filters.
